description: Check the verification progress of a strategy. Shows all verification phases and their results, and — once the backtest has run or was refused — backtest_verdict: reason_codes (FEW_TRADES, CONDITION_NEVER_FIRES:<i>, WIN_RATE, DRAWDOWN, PROFIT_FACTOR, …; INSUFFICIENT_DATA, INVALID_CONDITIONS or BACKTEST_REFUSED when it did not run), the constraints a house bot would carry into its next attempt, condition_stats (which condition never fired), and the gate applied next to the house rule for the timeframe.
name: get_verification_status
